Mother '''Grubb''' is a woman from [[Caemlyn]] who, by description, sounds like a [[Wisdom]].

==History==
She sell herbs, attends births and tends the sick. She lives two streets over from the Queen's Blessing.

==Activities==
Mother Grubb is suggested to [[Rand]] by [[Master Gill]] when [[Mat]] is sick. Rand does not request her services.
